content: Root cause: The bug was caused by an incorrect handling of the snake's direction when it attempted to move into itself. The original code had a conditional check that prevented the snake from changing direction if it had a length greater than 1, which was likely intended to prevent self-collision. However, this logic was flawed as it did not allow the snake to change direction properly when it was not moving into itself, leading to unexpected behavior. The patch corrects this by allowing the direction to be updated to the new direction unless it is directly opposite to the current direction, thus fixing the movement logic.
